description:
I am an Associate Professor in Computer Science and Engineering with a Ph.D. and passionate about developing innovative technology solutions to address real-world challenges. Our project aims to develop AI-powered Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts on Space Missions, focusing on real-time vital sign monitoring, health-risk prediction, anomaly detection, and intelligent alerts to support astronaut well-being.

I welcome enthusiastic team members with skills in Python, AI/ML.
